pinned_repo_head_note: gate on authored blob hashes below, not on live HEAD (CODEX target discipline; sibling experiments commit concurrently, EXP-0082 precedent)

target.note: the only device used; A18 Pro HANDS-OFF, M5 out of scope. All testing local, no SSH.

case_matrix.generator: analysis/gen_matrix.py:build_matrix() -- FIXED, non-adaptive, same order both runs

groups.R: re-validation of A18 EXP-0030 (2 renders + 3 static byte-extraction + 3 iotrace DATA-TRACE)
groups.B: object-to-mesh payload size: 11-point PAYLOAD_BYTES ladder bracketing the confirmed 16384/16385 boundary + 8-point payloadMemoryLength override ladder
groups.C: UVB output sizing: 14-point NV (max_vertices) ladder bracketing confirmed 256/257 + 15-point NP (max_primitives, NV=256 fixed) ladder bracketing confirmed 512/513
groups.D: allocation ownership / raster linkage: 13-point AMP_COUNT (threadgroups-per-mesh-grid) ladder bracketing confirmed silent-zero-output boundary at 65536 + 3 iotrace BO-size-multiset checkpoints (small/near-max/high-amp)
groups.I: indirect + ICB mesh dispatch: 9-point indirect-grid-X ladder (+ misaligned/OOB offset probes) + 5 icb_cpu + 5 icb_gpu range/barrier cases + 12-point icb maxCommandCount ladder bracketing the two crash-boundary regions found during calibration

case_matrix.build_time_calibration_source: manual ad-hoc probing (recorded in PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 0) + one full non-recorded dry run work/smoke/smoke01/ -- both predate this freeze and are NOT gated evidence; they informed ladder placement only

process_isolation: one case = one OS process (mesh_probe / iohello_* / shdump_*), never batched, never reused across cases

gate.byte_exact_payload: per-case: status (classified terminal state), and for iotrace-bearing records: n_bo/sel9_calls/total_calls/size_multiset/selector_histogram; for R-bytes-* static extraction: stage _agc.main hex sha256 + length + e7-count + frame_marker-count facts
excluded_from_gate: GPU addresses/handles inside stdout (present but not compared)
raw stdout text byte-for-byte (only the parsed STATUS/COVERED/facts fields are gated)
gate.smoke_gate: NON-RECORDED full dry run against work/smoke/ must pass before any raw/ capture (work/smoke/smoke01/, executed pre-freeze)
gate.selftest: synthetic fixtures + a real recorded fixture drawn from work/smoke/smoke01/ (post-freeze copy, see analysis/fixtures/)
gate.run_id_policy: never reuse; a defective capture is retained and superseded by a new id, never repaired in place
